'''Ruul''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ruul system/Legends|Ruul system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It fell into the hands of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which imported [[Human/Legends|Human]] prisoners to the planet and strip-mined it.

==History==
The planet fell into the hands of the Empire sometime before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when it was being aggressively strip-mined by the Empire, as well as playing host to multiple computer complexes in which were stored vast amounts of data. It also became the site of [[Tarkin Detention Facility]], an Imperial prison.

[[File:Sounder_Flats.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Sounder Flats computer complex]].]]

It was in that year that [[Grand General/Legends|Grand General]] [[Malcor Brashin]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brenn Tantor]] arrived and discovered that [[Ruul computer complex|one of the computer complexes]] had fallen into the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Tantor [[Assault on Ruul|took back]] the computer complex and stretched a line of [[remote relay beacon]]s to a nearby [[Ruul uplink tower|broadcast antenna]] from which the complex's data was uploaded to the [[Inquisitor (Star Destroyer)|''Inquisitor'']], revealing important information on Rebel movements.

Near the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], a [[Ruulian Rebels|rebellion]] broke out on Ruul, which [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] major [[Dellis Tantor]] was sent to squelch. Perhaps because Tantor's mission was only a cover for his capture by the Empire in which he had lost faith, the insurrection was still ongoing when Brenn Tantor [[Mission to Ruul (Galactic Civil War)|returned]] to the planet as a Rebel several months after his brother's assignment. Tantor freed [[Beri Tulon]] from Tarkin Detention Facility and conducted an information raid on the [[Sounder Flats computer complex|computer complex]] at [[Sounder Flats]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I am Major Brenn Tantor. Perhaps you have heard of my recent success against the Rebellion on Sriluur's moon, Ruul?|Major Tantor|<ref name="SWG:ED">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Empire Day}}</ref>}}
The Imperial [[assault on Ruul]] was mentioned by Brenn Tantor in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. However, the game confused the planet Ruul with [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur's]] moon of [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]].<ref name="SWG:ED" />
